integrity.method: exact finite-sum proof and independent arithmetic checks

scientific_limitations: Fixed three-species iid perfect-detection model; sign classification local in imbalance, not a global 3-simplex classification.
Broader qualitative failure of pairwise variance smoothing was already noted in 2026; the contribution is the exact one-parameter rare-abundance threshold and its quartic endpoint.
Historical priority for the precise phase threshold has not received an independent literature audit; a relevant short 2017 note was not available in full text.
title: A rare-species threshold for the variance response to balancing common species
